name: atlanai-analytics
description: Prepare a link, local folder or BI export for talk-to-data in Claude or Codex: survey dashboards and query history, select scope, preview metrics and SQL, publish to Atlan and ask questions from released context. Also supports warehouse analytics and explicit agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Publish analytics context and ask your data with Atlan
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on the Atlan registry. Ask a data question and get an answer from your published metrics and saved queries, with the definition it used. Mine your warehouse's query history into managed metrics and saved queries, build a talk-to-data agent that reads them, measure it against a local eval set and improve it round by round, or propose a metric fix from a conversation. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and asks you to connect one when it is missing. It uses the Atlan plugin's connection. Turn a Power BI dashboard into SQL metrics, compare dashboard answers, evaluate a fresh Claude or Codex agent and ask questions from released definitions.
defaultPrompt: Help me use this dashboard, folder or BI export to ask questions about my data
Build and test a talk-to-data agent from this Power BI dashboard
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's query history
